posts.title: Pull requests: quality theater with questionable results
posts.description: Does your organization prefer or maybe even force pull requests for reviewing and validating changes before integrating to a mainline? I have news for you: you’re engaged in quality theater and the only thing the PRs are doing for you is add cognitive load and delays while preventing you from finding better ways to ensure you’re shipping a quality product without delays.

posts.title: Quality by a thousand cuts
posts.description: Refactoring a codebase should be a continuous activity, even outside “regular feature development”.
